_source: CBP ruling N343953 (26 Nov 2024): transmission speed sensor, Chinese Hall effect IC soldered to a PCB and housed in Thailand: CBP held China. N344809 (10 Jan 2025): the Hall effect IC made in Thailand: CBP held Thailand. Both in the selection pool; both excluded.

product.name: Speed sensors (part numbers 20010031 and 20010104)
product.description: Speed sensors installed within the transmission system of a vehicle to provide speed information for wheels and turbines to the Transmission Control Unit. They consist of a Hall Effect sensor integrated circuit attached to a printed circuit board, enclosed within a plastic frame and shell with a connection point at one end.

operations.name: make the Hall effect sensor integrated circuit
Bending and soldering the leads of the Hall Effect IC to the PCB
Inserting the IC and PCB subassembly into the plastic frame and enclosing with the plastic shell
Inspecting, testing, and packaging the finished device
